browserProof.reason: Owner-disabled browser proof policy; no Playwright or headed browser verification was run.

topFindings: Current DAW is a real browser-native beta sketchpad, not a paid serious DAW.
Strong current capability: Web Audio sketching, import/decode/preview, mic recording, Web MIDI trigger, region edits, local loop packs, mixer sliders, local/SkyGate save, and browser WAV mixdown.
Saved projects record clip metadata but do not persist reconstructable clip audio.
Timeline is fixed to a 16-beat grid and needs arbitrary song length, zoom, sections, and markers.
Mixdown is mono browser WAV rendering, not production mastering/export infrastructure.
DAW Export downloads JSON only; backend queueExport exists in Export Forge/studio APIs but is not called by DAW Export.
Provider hooks expose provider/model inputs and must be wrapped behind kAIxU action aliases before self-serve AI.
Mounted 0S Worker marks generate-ai-song/create-ai-song as operator actions, which should remain true for expensive generation.
Shared FS27/SkyGate/Free99 auth posture is mostly correct; app-local identity is disabled.
Monetization should keep DAW free/beta and charge for storage, release handling, hands-on ops, and tightly metered kAIxU assistant credits.
recommendedNextActions: Add DAW assistant API with server-owned kAIxU model aliases and no raw provider/model UI.
Add AI entitlement, credit ledger, rate limits, provider circuit breakers, and idempotency keys.
Promote imported DAW clips to gated music-assets storage and restore saved sessions from asset IDs.
Wire DAW Export to backend queueExport and later an ffmpeg/offline render worker.
Add timeline drag/trim/resize, pan, fades, meters, arbitrary length, MIDI clips, and revision autosave.
